title: Fishing
wikitext:
[[File:Fisherman.png|thumb|right|A fisherman]] '''Fishing''' is the activity of trying to catch fish. There are many [[wikipedia:Easter egg (media)|Easter eggs]] in [[Path of Exile]] that are references to a running joke by [[Grinding Gear Games]] about the existence of secret gameplay features related to fishing. It has so far not been confirmed that any such gameplay features legitimately exist. ==List of fishing Easter eggs== {| class="wikitable" ! Version !
